release_notes.zh:
• 修复快速任务开场辅助异常导致多SP初始化中止的问题；快速任务卡片移到日志上方。
• 修复主菜单快速任务在出击准备时中止，以及片头Logo跳过的菜单识别错误。
• 增加主菜单快速测试任务入口、独立测试预设和启动自动出击选项。
• 增加启动时跳过片头Logo。
• 修复内部兵装切换打断原生长按附加功能的问题，保留玩家真实按住和松开。
• 增加默认开启的启动更新检查开关，可保存关闭；手动检测仍可用。
• 改善安装器在高DPI缩放下的字体清晰度。
• 放大F6作者水印，将反馈区统一为默认全部显示的卡片。
• 修复快速任务和任务内换机列表误隐藏部分已安装Mod机体的问题，保留DLC许可限制。
release_notes.en:
• Fixed quick-mission intro helper errors aborting multi-SP initialization, and moved the quick-mission card above the logs.
• Fixed quick launch stopping during main-menu preparation and incorrect menu identification when skipping startup logos.
• Added main-menu quick mission testing, separate test presets and optional automatic launch on startup.
• Added startup logo skipping.
• Fixed internal weapon switching interrupting native hold-button auxiliary functions, preserving the player's actual hold and release.
• Added a startup update check option, enabled by default. It can be disabled and saved; manual checks remain available.
• Improved installer text clarity at high DPI scaling.
• Enlarged the F6 author watermark and made feedback a matching card with all content always visible.
• Fixed some installed mod aircraft being hidden from quick mission and in-mission aircraft lists, while retaining DLC ownership checks.
